game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the heartwood tree using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The heartwood tree reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the heartwood tree is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Iteration Tracer' (Week 5 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mossy Creek'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mossy Creek.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The heartwood tree reached with actions_used <= 15.
